title: Raising Cain: The Son of Perdition, Merchants, and Captive Nations

sense.text:
“The prophets that have been before me and before thee of old prophesied both against many countries, and against great kingdoms, of war, and of evil, and of pestilence.” All the prophets made sure they spoke of war, evil and pestilence. Not because we want to talk about bad news: it is bad news for everybody else, but it is good news for us. When we see these things, we see the signs and the time hastening for the Lord’s people, the Lord’s heritage.

All of it is written in our holy scriptures, ours, the Israelites’, and it is relevant to us. Other nations are caught up in it, but it is written to us. Because all these things were prophesied, nothing is uncertain when we see them come to pass. It is an assurance and an establishment of our faith, and that is why these things have to keep being brought out. There is a time to prophesy of peace and a time to prophesy of war.

Look at verse 9 against verse 8. “The prophet which prophesieth of peace, when the word of the prophet shall come to pass, then shall the prophet be known, that the Lord hath truly sent him.” This is not a time of peace. The peace to come is peace for us: the middle wall of partition broken down between the northern and southern kingdom, no more alienation from Christ, his laws and our identity. As far as this present world is set up, it is not a time of peace.

So when the prophets begin to prophesy of peace and it comes to pass, you know there has been a shift: the end of this world, and the beginning that follows, is at hand. We prophesy of that end now. It should feel like waiting for the next episode of something you long for. It is scary, and it should be a self-assessment, but all praises to the Lord that we have the understanding now.

“Seek ye out of the book of the Lord, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate”. We must read and understand so we can see these things. Too many of our people, even people repenting, are caught up in other things and do not think what is happening is significant enough for their attention or do not see how it relates to them. Go back and read your scriptures more. The leadership brings these classes out for our people’s benefit: to put a fire under us so we seek out our own salvation with fear and trembling.

No other book gives this understanding. These words were inspired by the Lord and put through the prophets to pen and paper, and they survived countless attempts to burn, destroy and alter them. Christianity minimizes it to a book of love and hugs and kisses, and that is a slap in the face, because most of the book is doom, destruction, war, judgment and recompense. And a prophecy is never for all people: it is for a certain group, and the ones waiting on it are oppressed. The so-called Jews are not oppressed, not with the influence they have in the earth.

“For my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them.” Christ’s spirit gathered all these things together in a way that is plain to those who apply the commandments, and preserved so we can use them in these last days.

Cain brought “of the fruit of the ground an offering unto the Lord”, and Abel “of the firstlings of his flock and of the fat thereof.” “The Lord had respect unto Abel and to his offering: But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect. And Cain was very wroth, and his countenance fell.” It happened physically, but it is a foreshadowing that still deals with Jacob and Esau: one is chosen and one is not.

The offering was not the reason Cain was not chosen; that was ordained from the beginning. But when that first world was formed, everybody, whatever nation, was supposed to follow the laws, and where they did not, judgment had to follow. That rebellious nature of Cain manifested itself, and it continues to this day with Esau.

“Why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance fallen?” Remember this, because Genesis 27 shows the same reason Esau hates Jacob today is the reason Cain hated Abel. It is the same spirit; only the name changes later.

“If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.” He is talking about Satan: it is ordained from here that Satan rules over Cain. Satan simply means adversary, accuser, opposer, from a word meaning to obstruct or oppose. There is a spiritual Satan, but he works for the Lord (Job 1), and he has his own department and his own team. They were made for that purpose, to obstruct and oppose us, because God purposed it from the beginning. That is why everything they do is about us.

“Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.” It was not a head-on confrontation like two brothers squaring off in the street. He lured him in under the guise of being his brother wanting to talk, and murdered him: the same deceptive practices they use as they stab us in the back, because of all the hatred in his spirit against us.

The offering was rejected, his countenance fell, and his hatred was allowed to mature through a process of time; then he went and spoke to him. That is why the scripture warns us about grudges among ourselves, the root of bitterness, lest any be profane as Esau: the root of bitterness started with Cain. This was the first murder, and murder is progressive, not an impulse. It shows they rebel against God through violence. All the ways they oppress are violent, even their economic structure, which robs the so-called third world countries, because the wealth of the promises in Genesis 49 and Deuteronomy 33 is for Israel, where Israelites dwell.

“Where is Abel thy brother? And he said, I know not: Am I my brother’s keeper?” “The voice of thy brother’s blood crieth unto me from the ground. And now art thou cursed from the earth”.

The curse is layered, but the ultimate curse is the utter destruction of Cain and his seed, and it is not yet fulfilled. It is a deferred judgment, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled. It is the same spirit of Cain, and unless you embrace that and the revelation of who this man is, nothing else will make sense, because it is necessary for the Lord to set certain things in motion.

“A fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.” Think of the layers. Apart from the one land he had as the kingdom of Esau, he takes up the identity of others: he calls himself the Greeks (the real Greeks were black, of the Japhetic seed), the Romans, the Last Samurai, the Israelites in the Ten Commandments, the Egyptians. Daniel 9 speaks of confusion of faces for us; they flipped it on us. That was supposed to be their curse, and we are the ones walking around as an astonishment, a proverb and a byword.

“My punishment is greater than I can bear.” “Every one that findeth me shall slay me.” Every one that findeth him: there is a dispensation of time in these verses. As Deacon Malachi showed with the kingdom of Adam, many world events happened within these verses. What we get in Genesis is CliffsNotes, and much of the detail comes later or by revelation, through a glass darkly. It did not just jump from one thing to the next; that is Christianity and Catholicism.

“Whosoever slayeth Cain, vengeance shall be taken on him sevenfold. And the Lord set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.” The mark is the moment of deferred judgment. He was not judged then because God had a purpose for him, the same way he used Pharaoh in Romans 9: I let him rise in power so that my power could be magnified when I come to redeem my people and the earth.

That mark is sin, and sin preserves him because it bewitches: through it he seduces those who might be against him into a confederacy (Psalms 83). Even the other nations know what this man stands for, but the lust for money, power and rulership says, put that aside, I have to deal with this guy; like criminals making alliances knowing one day they will be stabbed in the back. Up to now he has generally kept his word with that confederacy, but under Trump you see the cracks and the hastening of the times. They talk of honor among thieves; not with this guy.

So Cain is protected for a time, his judgment deferred; but that judgment was promised, through Esau.

precepts.why:
Rebecca conceived by our father Isaac, “For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth”. One was chosen and one was not, and not because either did any evil. Cain’s wrath was not why he was not chosen. It was about election and the purpose God makes: later in the same chapter, vessels of wrath fitted for destruction: can I not make one thing for what I want and another for something else?

Christians take “not of works” to mean keeping the law does not matter. No: from the foundation he chose who his elect was, but he does require the works of the law. Not the sacrificial law, but us being clean and repented, to obtain the kingdom of heaven.

People say God doesn’t hate. They take God is love and isolate it. Then why does he say this? “As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.” “As it is written”: it is in the Bible, in Malachi.

So as we read about Cain, do not think the judgment came because of the offering. This was the nature of Cain, and that spirit continued throughout history and established God’s purpose.

“If I sin, then thou markest me, and thou wilt not acquit me from mine iniquity.” The sin is the mark. The mark on Cain is sin, and the mark is the deferred judgment: he is not acquitted, the judgment is only put off for a time.

Why would the mark of sin protect him? “For the bewitching of naughtiness doth obscure things that are honest”. Sin is witchcraft. It is bewitching and seductive; if it were possible, even the elect would be deceived by it.

So with that mark he would have rulership for a time, and he would rule the earth with darkness, sin and evil, and people would be enticed by it, Israelites included. The northern kingdom fell for it, the majority of them, and now they are getting their wake-up call; though there was always a remnant that rebelled against the colonialism in Latin America.

“I have loved you, saith the Lord.” “Was not Esau Jacob’s brother? saith the Lord: yet I loved Jacob, And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste”. This is the place Romans 9 points to when it says it is written.

Esau went through some things at different times: they became the cavemen, came out of the caves and began to take people’s identities, the fugitives and vagabonds that they were. But the permanent judgment was deferred for a set time. “Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places”: in the Renaissance they did. “Thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down”: I let them come to power so I can take them down.

“And they shall call them, The border of wickedness, and, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.” The border of wickedness is the mark. Judgment was reserved for him, but God needed to use him for a time for his plan.

“The earth is given into the hand of the wicked: he covereth the faces of the judges thereof; if not, where, and who is he?” If it is not Esau, if it is not the United States of America, who is he?

The image of the leaders seated together, the president with the vice president and the speaker in a hierarchy, and the same at the UN on a bigger scale: that is what the prophets saw in vision when Psalms and the rest speak of them being confederate together. Visions come partly as similitude and partly as the real thing, like Peter’s vision in Acts 10, which was never about food. They saw the flags of the nations on one accord, with their power structures and hierarchies.

The judgment was deferred, for a time. Cain pleaded, the Lord set a mark. Revenge is a dish best served cold: how much better to let this man get so high in power that he thinks he can stop God, and then take him down.

“And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled.” There is a set time of these heathen nations that has to be fulfilled, with Esau at the top: the same spirit of Cain in rulership. But it is temporary.

“The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee”. In the process of time, generation after generation, waiting for this judgment, his pride has deceived him: he forgot what his judgment is, or his pomp is such that he thinks he is untouchable. Who could blame him? Russia and China were supposed to be the ones he worried about, and look what was just done to their air defenses in Venezuela.

“Thou that dwellest in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?” Trump is talking like that now. But it is prophesied who will bring him down: first all those he dealt with will turn against him, and then Christ and his elect will have the glory and honor of taking him down.

Trump stressed it himself about taking Maduro: it was fast and violent, very violent; the same man who understood what raising Cain meant when he met his general. “Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.” You reap what you sow, and the violence he puts out is exactly the way his demise will come.

sense.text:
The wicked are revealed, restrained for a time with a hedge around them to fulfil what the Lord wants, and then their final judgment. Look at the lineage and the spirit of violence that came out of it. Tubal-cain was “an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron”: he worked metal, and that was tools of war, not decorations for the house. The mark followed Cain’s line, with sin, violence and hatred in his spirit. Where an artist sees something unformed and brings forth beauty, his mind saw weapons.

Weaponry came into the earth, or at least was advanced, through Cain’s lineage. Murder led to industry, hatred led to technology, and violence led to institutional power, hegemony, control over everything.

precepts.why:
Esau wept for a blessing, and Isaac answered: “Behold, thy dwelling shall be the fatness of the earth, and of the dew of heaven from above; And by thy sword shalt thou live”. Here is the connection: rulership and authority, and everything, the fatness of the earth, he gets by violence.

“And shalt serve thy brother; and it shall come to pass when thou shalt have the dominion, that thou shalt break his yoke from off thy neck.” That happened once our kingdom fell; we have never been in power since, and that was his increase through the process of time.

“Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire”: the Lord says I created this. God is over all of it, even when it comes through his emissary: he puts it on Satan and Satan passes it around.

It is twofold. The smith is the brass and iron, but then “that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.” An instrument means one in particular, not all weaponry, and he calls it the waster. What weapon at that time could be called the waster? Nothing. Like the Oppenheimer movie, they love to document it.

The characteristics of the waster: “And this shall be the plague wherewith the Lord will smite all the people that have fought against Jerusalem; Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet, and their eyes shall consume away in their holes, and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth.” No weapon anybody could fathom then did that. Flesh, eyes and tongue wasting away as they stand.

“For, behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven”. There will be a day when that plague is fulfilled. God put it on man to make an instrument called the waster. The prophets did not know about nuclear weapons, atoms and atomics; they got these visions and explained them as best they could, and the best way to say it was: the waster.

“And all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble”: not just Esau and the other nations, but rebellious Israel that does not repent. “The day that cometh shall burn them up, saith the Lord of hosts, that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.” Fire leaves ashes; this waster leaves nothing. After a nuclear blast the body does not survive the heat; you are totally gone.

Still with the violent man raising Cain. “The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering to us-ward”. The only reason it tarries is that the Lord is waiting for us. It is not a set date we know; the time is when the set number is sealed, and God knows when that will be.

“But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night”, when you least suspect it, “in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat”. In those days they could not imagine what that was. Now we understand, and it is no less terrifying, because we know what the nukes can do. The Lord stays their hand: they know with their treaties that if one of them uses one, the other answers, and it is a wrap, a zero-sum game, like the game where using the nuke ends the game because the whole earth is destroyed.

“Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness”. It should move us, not just be heard.

“For yourselves know perfectly that the day of the Lord so cometh as a thief in the night”, the same as Peter. “Therefore let us not sleep, as do others; but let us watch and be sober.” That soberness is the manner of conversation, holiness and godliness. “But let us, who are of the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love; and for an helmet, the hope of salvation.” Sobriety means do not drink of the mark of the beast, do not drink of her wine, do not be so asleep thinking you are an American and nothing can touch you.

“For God hath not appointed us to wrath, but to obtain salvation by our Lord Jesus Christ”: he does not want his elect in that death and destruction. “That, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him”: if you die in this life you still get the honor of being raised first, to see and take part in the taking of the kingdom.

“Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another”. Comfort yourselves knowing it will not touch you if these things are followed. It is a time to come together stronger and unified, not divided over simple issues: as these things come, there should be growth in faith and understanding and the application behind it.

“Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God”: we should look boldly and say, I want it to come quickly. “Wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat?” What else could it be talking about?

“Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.” Do not worry that it will be burned away: that is a baptism by fire that cleanses the evil and re-forms the earth so it is fit for our new forms and the new kingdom. Thy will be done in earth as it is in heaven: the kingdom comes down and this place has to be transformed, like the terraforming in Man of Steel, but it will not go down their way.

“Moreover the multitude of thy strangers shall be like small dust”, with this waster, “and the multitude of the terrible ones shall be as chaff that passeth away: yea, it shall be at an instant suddenly.” That is not regular fire, which takes time to burn; this happens in an instant.

“Thou shalt be visited of the Lord of hosts with thunder, and with earthquake, and great noise, with storm and tempest, and the flame of devouring fire.” “The multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel”: Ariel means the lion of God, so it is those who fight against Christ and his elect, “even all that fight against her and her munition”, the munition being the weapons. They “shall be as a dream of a night vision”: gone as quickly as a dream fades or a vision disappears.

And here is the beauty of it: God put their spirit to make that thing, and he will use that same thing to end them, the very thing they feel gave them their power and respect. “It shall even be as when an hungry man dreameth, and, behold, he eateth; but he awaketh, and his soul is empty”. They lived deliciously, bellies full, never thirsty, and in an instant all of it will be gone.

sense.text:
“For I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt. If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.” Lamech did cold-blooded murder, with no anger behind it. If Cain is to be judged for killing in anger, how much more Lamech, who did it with nothing but violence in him? And how does he know about Cain? Because he is Cain’s seed, like the Jeffrey Dahmers who kill for the thrill of killing.

He boasted in that violence. It went beyond Cain; it increased. This is when murder was normalized and celebrated for them.

precepts.why:
This is why Esau has this spirit. “And Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing wherewith his father blessed him: and Esau said in his heart, The days of mourning for my father are at hand; then will I slay my brother Jacob.” It is in his spirit, to this day.

“Behold, thy brother Esau, as touching thee, doth comfort himself, purposing to kill thee.” It is a comfort to them. Trump said of Venezuela it was violent, very violent, and of the boats, we’re just going to kill them; no law, just kill them. They comfort themselves with violence.

“Now therefore, my son, obey my voice; and arise, flee thou to Laban my brother to Haran”. The only thing you can do is flee from his bloodthirsty violence; there is nothing you can do against it. It is the same spirit as Cain: patient, vengeful and calculated. As Cain lured Abel, Esau says I’ll wait till the days of mourning are done and get him when he least suspects it: cold, calculated precision. Murder of a brother repeats itself like a ring: Cain killed Abel, Esau wants to kill Jacob.

sense.text:
“Let no man deceive you by any means: for that day shall not come, except there come a falling away first, and that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition”. The churches never spend time here. The son of perdition has to be revealed before the promises are fulfilled, before Christ comes to avenge us, because he wants to magnify his power in who he took down. We have to know who it speaks of for the hastening of our king’s return.

It says revealed, not elected. This was not raised up late in the game; he was ordained from the foundation of the world, and all we are getting now is the revelation. The mark was the deferred judgment for a dispensation of time. So there should be rejoicing, bittersweet as it is: like watching the Latin American leaders talk strong with caution in their voices because they have no might in their hand, as frustrated as the kid whose lunch money is taken and who knows he cannot take the bully. It just has to be made known.

“Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped; so that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.” He says: I’m God, I’m Christ, I’m the Hebrews; with that false image of Cesare Borgia that everybody worships. The son of perdition reveals himself by exalting himself. Who exalts himself in these last days, who opposes God, who seeks worship? It is this man.

“And then shall that Wicked be revealed, whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth”. That is literally when he comes; but for now the spirit of his mouth is the revelation, by the prophets preaching, as Jeremiah said at the start. “And shall destroy with the brightness of his coming”: that is literal, and what goes before the brightness of his coming is the nuclear bombs.

“Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan”: Cain, Esau. “With all power and signs and lying wonders”: the atomic bomb, the weapons, the power of the industrial complex, globalism, the wealth, money and economics. With that power in the earth comes deception, hand in hand. They used the signs and wonders falsely with the bomb, then with Bretton Woods and the gold-backed dollar, and when that failed, the petrodollar, which is why oil is so important to keep their currency flowing. Lawlessness hides behind their authority: we’re in charge, so what we say is right.

“And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness”: that mark, that bewitching of sin, “in them that perish”, in all the other nations and in Israel that does not repent. “Because they received not the love of the truth, that they might be saved”: that is the Israelites who receive not the love of the truth.

“And for this cause God shall send them strong delusion, that they should believe a lie”. He keeps their eyes closed. That is why people who were here for years go back to their vomit, keeping none of it, sometimes worse; and if it could happen to them, who am I to say it could not happen to me if I don’t keep myself on the straight and narrow. They are damned who “had pleasure in unrighteousness”: pleasure in that mark.

precepts.why:
Remember Thessalonians says he will be revealed, not elected or raised up: he was already ordained. “In the beginning, when the earth was made, before the borders of the world stood, or ever the winds blew, Before it thundered and lightened”, before the angels were gathered, before the firmament was measured, “before they were sealed that have gathered faith for a treasure”. Before he started anything, he had a plan and a vision.

“Then did I consider these things, and they all were made through me alone, and through none other: by me also they shall be ended, and by none other.” All of it was planned before anything was made, as an artist sees the work in his mind first.

“What shall be the parting asunder of the times? or when shall be the end of the first, and the beginning of it that followeth?” And the answer: “Jacob’s hand held first the heel of Esau. For Esau is the end of the world, and Jacob is the beginning of it that followeth.” You want to know when the end is? Esau is the end, and you have to watch the signs to understand when. The judgment was deferred for a time, but Jacob is the beginning of what follows.

Some say Jacob grabbed him and stole the birthright. But if this was done from the foundation, as it was in Cain’s spirit to do what he did, is Jacob at fault? No: neither did good or evil in the womb. It was a reflex in the spirit, a sign done for our learning. Jacob was always supposed to be in power; we were always supposed to rule, but because of sin the earth was not subdued the way it should have been. Jacob was not wrong in his spirit, but it was not for then; it was for a time.

Christ, of his elect in this present world: “While I was with them in the world, I kept them in thy name”, by ministering to us, giving us the word, magnifying the law, breaking down the divisions between us, showing us how to be unified under the commandments in the faith of Christ. “Those that thou gavest me I have kept, and none of them is lost”: they are sealed. Another verse in John 17 that smashes the John 3:16 doctrine.

“But the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled.” That is 2 Esdras 6:9-10: they are preserved so the end, and the beginning after it, can happen. The elect are kept, through the godliness and holiness of Peter and Thessalonians and coming together; the son of perdition is not kept, he is ordained for destruction. Through the process of time Cain elevates himself in his bloodline, puts in place institutions, banking and the rest, and becomes a global power.

Remember they come after the working of Satan. “That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased! The Lord hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers.” God has to break it, because it is a bewitching, a spell.

“He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke”: the continual stroke is his sanctions, his oppression by war, his threat of dominance and his economics. Try to break away from their currency, their dollar, their structure, and you will be broken. “He that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted, and none hindereth”: it gets flipped on him. Today it is tariffs and threats over Greenland, and tariffs hurt us too.

“The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.” When he is gone, all creation rejoices; the earnest expectation of the creature waits for the manifestation of the sons of God. “Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying, Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.” The trees are nations and people, and nature itself. A feller chops down forests: he is the destroyer of nations. Peace only comes to the earth after he is out of power, because violence has been his spirit from the beginning. That which is crooked cannot be made straight; the Lord formed him that way, a vessel of wrath fitted for destruction.

“Thy pomp is brought down to the grave”, as in Obadiah 3: “the worm is spread under thee, and the worms cover thee.” “How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning!” His workings are after Satan, and Lucifer, the illuminated one, is associated with Satan; he is wiser than Daniel, because he is in authority to do all that. Christianity made it an adversary that rebelled against God. They so dumb: how could anything God created rise to rival the omnipotent, omnipresent God? He is fallen, “which didst weaken the nations!”

So he went from the murderer of his brother, to a weapon maker, to a global oppressor. Cain murders his brother; his lineage builds weapons; that spirit comes through Esau, who plots to murder his brother; Isaiah 14 reveals the oppressor of nations; and 2 Thessalonians 2 shows the man of sin fully manifested in these last days. The spirit did not disappear; it evolved, from individual murder to institutional violence to global domination. Asked what could stop him, Trump said: nothing but my own morality. And where are his morals? He’s a pedophile, and they keep blacking out the Epstein files.

sense.text:
Now how they operate: the merchants and the captive nations. “Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?” They wrote the laws, so they know how to get around them; the cartel story is how. The president’s pen is the most powerful pen in the world, and the other nations know the most powerful position on earth is the president of the United States and bend the knee, talk strong as they may.

They do not abandon the law; they weaponize it, as with the Department of Justice. Violence gets reframed legally with decrees: the Donroe Doctrine, the Roosevelt Corollary, Operation Enduring Freedom, Operation Absolute Resolve. Kidnapping becomes law enforcement. Sanctions become international order. Theft becomes stabilizing the region. That is framing mischief by a law.

Another example: he said they would lock up the criminal illegal immigrants. You thought criminal meant thieves, rapists and murderers, but by their laws being here without coming through their system is itself the crime, so a law-abiding person becomes a criminal. That is how he got the dummies, the ones outraged now, to vote for him.

“Woe to them that devise iniquity, and work evil upon their beds! when the morning is light, they practise it”. When the morning is light means broad daylight: they can frame mischief by law, and the only thing to stop him is his own morality. “Because it is in the power of their hand”: they are after the working of Satan, given that authority and power. They set kings up and take them down.

“And they covet fields, and take them by violence; and houses, and take them away: so they oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.” It is not only the resources; they want the identity too. Venezuela’s vice president said Zionists attacked the country to enslave it. Netanyahu was there just before. Maduro said, I’m Christian, but in my blood I’m a Jew, Sephardic, of the twelve tribes, and Netanyahu is no real Jew. Everybody laughs when we say they are fake, but even Edom is getting hip that Israelis are not Israelites, though not yet that we are. Whether people credit it or not, the word does not go out void, and we know who is doing that work with boots on the ground all over the world, teaching all the tribes. That applause is for the Lord.

Machado, that freaking skank, opened her legs like the scripture says of the northern kingdom: she as good as said, we will open up the oil to all you companies, come and rape the land and take what you want. She promised to move Venezuela’s embassy to Jerusalem, playing to where the power lies: everybody has to bow the knee to the imposters. The ADL says it watches people around the clock and trains law enforcement, the diligent search. They tried for Patagonia, starting fires with Israeli grenades, buying up land and businesses and pushing our people out. They produce nothing but lies, hypocrisy, doctrines, slander and defamation; their main function is to preserve the lie that they are the Israelites and Jews the Bible speaks of, and they cannot do it without America. They let health subsidies lapse for lack of money, and sent billions to Israel.

Babylon is first a commercial empire. They use military power to protect their trade, and merchants mourn when the system collapses. Trade is not neutral: it is the economic spine of the empire.

“He is a merchant, the balances of deceit are in his hand: he loveth to oppress.” This speaks of Ephraim. The balances of deceit: he dealt deceitfully in business. “And Ephraim said, Yet I am become rich, I have found me out substance: in all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that were sin.”

When you deal deceitfully, even in economics, that is not how God wants things set up. Capitalism is in no way how the Lord intended us to live and sustain ourselves, economically or agriculturally. Ephraim learned it from the other nations by mixing among them and picking up their practices. That is why we watch for a nation that could not help us: their practices are against the scriptures, and get in bed with the United States and they will always pull the blanket out from under you.

They talk fair markets only when it benefits them, enforced with the military; what they love is deceitful trade, like Trump buying bonds right around the Netflix and Warner Brothers deal. They love gain, trust in wealth and oppress through commerce, and Ephraim, always married to the other nations, mimicked them.

This model comes from ancient empire. Trump’s base is cult-like, immoral, united under a grievance: white rage. They tell them they don’t have to be ashamed to be white anymore; when were they ever? The ICE agents moving the way they do have drunk the Kool-Aid.

“King Antiochus wrote to his whole kingdom, that all should be one people, And every one should leave his laws: so all the heathen agreed according to the commandment of the king. Yea, many also of the Israelites consented to his religion”. The heathen agreed, and there were Israelites on board too. They called it a religion. People say Trump is the first to make politics a religion; not true. He is raising Cain, bringing back the old practices. This was under the Greeks.

“Profane the sabbaths and festival days: And pollute the sanctuary and holy people”: everything contrary to God. For the other nations it does not matter, because those things (the stars and the moon) were made for them, but what they want is for us “To the end they might forget the law, and change all the ordinances.”

“And whosoever would not do according to the commandment of the king, he said, he should die.” Trump says Venezuela must align with our interests, and Colombia, Mexico and Cuba. Antiochus issued decrees to force conformity, and the same thing happens now: laws replace customs, worship and culture, governance gets overridden, and whoever opposes the assimilation is come after hard; and they can back it up.
Judas heard that the Romans “were mighty and valiant men, and such as would lovingly accept all that joined themselves unto them, and make a league of amity with all that came unto them”.

“And that by their policy and patience they had conquered all the place, though it were very far from them”. Their policy and their patience: they put things in place and move a certain way, and one modern form of it is the School of the Americas. They gave the kings that came against them “a great overthrow, so that the rest did give them tribute every year”. When they can back it up with military power, everybody else falls in line.

“They destroyed and brought under their dominion all other kingdoms and isles that at any time resisted them”: resist and you will be crushed. “But with their friends and such as relied upon them they kept amity”, those relying on them for military strength. “All that heard of their name were afraid of them”: they no longer even have to send the military. They send an emissary with their conditions and the threat, and nations far away say, we’ll roll with you. Rome was that powerful, and so is the US: it is commerce now, enforced by the threat of military power, as everyone saw in Venezuela. Nobody throws the first punch.

“Also that, whom they would help to a kingdom, those reign; and whom again they would, they displace: finally, that they were greatly exalted”. It is still the spirit of Cain coming through Esau: Greece, then Rome, and the Roman pattern did not disappear; it evolved. Rome trained proxy rulers, like Herod, an Edomite ruling over us in Israel; America trains proxy militaries and governments. Rome removed kings who resisted; America removes leaders who resist. Regime grooming, military training programs, promotion of democracy, hemispheric policing.

Fifty-six US military interventions in Latin America since 1890, beginning with the banana wars, when the people tried to nationalize their agriculture and America intervened for the corporations its officials own. In 1946 they formalized it in the School of the Americas, renamed in 2001 the Western Hemisphere Institute for Security Cooperation to sound less imposing. More than 60,000 Latin American military and police passed through it by 2000, and until 1984 it sat in the Panama Canal Zone; Panama itself was broken off from Gran Colombia with US influence so they could have the canal. Its manuals spelled out torture, to be used by those militaries on their own people: there they trained the very dictators they later called dictators, the ungodly wretches who turned on their people, and when one like Noriega tried to change, they changed the narrative on him. Its hall of fame honored those who executed the spirit of Cain, and its emblem has the cross, the sword and the torch, the light like Lucifer, like that harlot. The migration from Latin America is the fruit of it, Micah 2:1-2 again.

precepts.why:
“They have set up kings, but not by me”. Ephraim, the northern kingdom, did the same with Assyria and with Egypt: always going to other countries for leverage, never realizing all we had to do was return to God, reunite with the southern kingdom and keep his commandments as one people. We see those same tendencies to this day: when the United States became a world power, they set up kings. “They have made princes, and I knew it not”: through the School of the Americas.

“Of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.” They traded their resources and leveraged them to put these people over them. Whom they would help, they helped; whom they would weaken, they weakened; whom they would remove, they removed. That sums up the School of the Americas.

The third world is not poor: the Philippines, Brazil, Mexico, Chile are rich; only the people are poor. For four hundred years they carved out the timber, cocoa, rum, tin, copper, iron, rubber and the slaves. These countries are not underdeveloped; they are overexploited. They should be rich nations and world powers with the blessings the Lord gave us in these places.

It is what Revelation says: “The merchandise of gold, and silver, and precious stones” down to “and chariots, and slaves, and souls of men.” They did the same in Africa, where we fled, especially the west coast, and the northern kingdom is there too. Get the stereotype out of your head; some of us still keep our color. The slave routes and trade routes were the commerce they made of us. Because our people do not see grand-scale wars, they miss it: the influence is economic, maintained by the threat of military power.

There is a pattern they follow every time, six steps, as with Noriega and now Maduro. First they criminalize the leader with drug, terror and corruption narratives: Psalms 94:20, framing mischief by a law. Then they declare the regime illegitimate: Hosea 8:4. Then sanctions and economic siege, the modern form of the curse: “Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the Lord shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things”. Try to nationalize your resources or deal outside their money, and even with your own resources you are overexploited until you cannot stand on your own. No might in your hand.

“And he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” Many times we did it willingly, the same pattern as with Assyria and Egypt, and when the United States became a world power, with them; and we found out quickly they keep their word on nothing. Then they isolate the nation diplomatically and militarily, remove or extract the leadership, and install a transition authority. History repeating; the doctrine of the scripture executed over and over.

“I know thy works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but thou art rich)”. First and foremost the riches are the promise of the kingdom of heaven: unto us pertain the promises, the law and the adoption, whom Christ died for. That is the true riches. But brought up to now, it shows we have riches in our countries as well: rich in resources, and the people poor because they are overexploited.

“And I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.” We just saw that in how they move with them to oppress our people.

sense.text:
Most Venezuelans are not celebrating; those celebrating in Miami descend from the white elite that benefited when American companies were there, and some are hungry and tired of being broke. You cannot lump all who rebel against it together as Edom.

“The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.” It goes two ways: sinners put among the people, for not all Israel is Israel; and the blanqueamiento of the northern kingdom here in the Western Hemisphere, which had no equal historically until the Spaniards did it.

“Then appeared the tares also.” A mixing happened: bad seed sown among the good. “Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field?” Didn’t you set this up knowing who the Israelites were? “From whence then hath it tares?”

“An enemy hath done this.” It was done on purpose. Blanqueamiento, whitening, was a social, political and economic practice across Latin America to improve the race, mejorando la raza, a phrase still heard where they push our people to marry white. It was symbolic, a white-supremacist ideology that all that is white is right with a caste system behind it, and biological, marrying lighter to have lighter children. Our captivity began with Assyria and all our mixing, but nothing in captivity matched this deliberate effort under the Spaniards to whiten us, to dilute the holy seed and breed us out, another form of eugenics.

They kept track and named every mixture, so they knew who still had an Israelite father however diluted. However watered down through the woman, one man with the seed of an Israelite returns it to the true heritage. They found the tribes and, unable to kill us outright as they tried, they polluted the royal seed. So the northern kingdom has the light-against-dark division too, done on purpose. And all skin folk ain’t kinfolk: you can be blacker than the ace of spades and be the damn seed of Cain.

“Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.” Because of the way this went down, it is not for you to determine who is and who isn’t. “Let both grow together until the harvest”: at the harvest the Lord reveals who is Israel. The angels, when they come to redeem us, will know who is Israel and who is not.

precepts.why:
Some knuckleheads say this is not what the wheat and tares speak of. “For, lo, I will command, and I will sift the house of Israel among all nations”: among all nations, because through the blanqueamiento and the captivities God himself has to be the one to sift us. We still go where our people gather, the chief places of concourse, the highways and hedges where our people are, not the rich European neighborhoods.

“Like as corn is sifted in a sieve, yet shall not the least grain fall upon the earth.” Who is who will be determined: my sheep hear my voice, and you know them by their works. Even Adam walks through a gate; there are twelve gates with twelve names, and nobody sneaks through. God said he will do it.

“All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword, which say, The evil shall not overtake nor prevent us.” He will kill many of them, before, during and after.

sense.text: “Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people”: sometimes willingly, sometimes not. You have knuckleheads who say this speaks only of their customs. We just read that blanqueamiento was biological and symbolic, dummy, and the scholars document it. It says he mixed himself among the people; that was not just ideology. “Ephraim is a cake not turned”: the colors. Some of us are light, some in between, some dark; some have blonde hair and blue eyes with a straight Israelite father.

“Strangers have devoured his strength”: the strength of the royal seed, and our strength in the Lord, for the joy of the Lord is our strength. We cannot fight the United States; it is time to come back to God. “Yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knoweth not.” Many of our elders are not hearing it; gray hairs are on our heads and we cannot accept it.

precepts.why:
The Bible proves it was not just ideology. “The nation of Israel, the princes, the priests and Levites, have not put away from them the strange people of the land”. We did not put them away; we sought after them, because blanqueamiento was mejorando la raza. “Nor the pollutions of the Gentiles”: their idolatry and doctrines, as we became corrupt in our merchandising and commerce. All Israel had that propensity.

“For both they and their sons have married with their daughters, and the holy seed is mixed with the strange people of the land”. Mixed: when it says mixed himself among the people, the seed gets mixed. The Bible defines the Bible, and this is the scripture to put before anybody who says otherwise. “The rulers and the great men have been partakers of this iniquity.” We all partook of it, and it is a sin to mix with the other nations.

Still with the mixing: it was not just ideological, dummies, and some of these men went to seminary school and call themselves theologians. Get out of here. “But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.” Learning their works is the other side of it, but mingled, by its definition, goes into the mixing, as 1 Esdras shows. Keep it all together with Matthew 13 and Amos 9, especially you northern kingdom brothers; and southern kingdom, learn northern kingdom history with the same zeal, as fishers of men for every kind of fish that pertains to Israel.

“Mine heritage is unto me as a speckled bird, the birds round about are against her”. We are a speckled bird, and the birds round about, the enemy, are against us. While we are mixed, they know who we are because of that caste system; in Panama they have their names for the light and the dark among us.

But the Lord had a way to fix it, because the Israelite seed is that strong. “Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, is planted in a pleasant place”: the blessings, as in Genesis 49. “But Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer”: blanqueamiento, sometimes willingly, sometimes not, and the murderer is Cain, Esau, Edom, the Spaniards, the United States.

“Give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.” Many of the babies of those who tried to whiten died out, so what is left behind is largely not European; many Europeans there came later. Our job is to give the word in the chief places where our people resort, as Christ taught, and let God do the separating.

sense.text:
People think our identity was fabricated in the last few years, but it was passed down in song and dance through four hundred years of being stripped of it; our coming back to it was never supposed to happen, and they cannot wrap their minds around it. They will let a he be a she, but let us find our identity and it is called ignorant and hateful. If we had all been in one place, they would have wiped us out; scattered to the four corners, we were preserved, like the worm in Swordfish broken up and hidden across the whole internet. What was our curse, God meant for good. People say Trump is playing 3D chess, 4D chess; get out of here with your nonsense, you freaking cultist. This is God’s grand plan to preserve his people, and in our afflictions was our way out, our redemption.

“Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the Lord thy God”. This is the grand plan. “And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.” The curses became our identity, and our redemption: that is how we acknowledge ourselves and make our way back. As it is with the wicked, so here: if not these curses, then who is it?

precepts.why:
“Moreover this was not enough for them, that they erred in the knowledge of God; but whereas they lived in the great war of ignorance”. We have to wake up from that war of ignorance; in our affliction we will seek him early, and now we understand these times. “Those so great plagues called they peace.” This is not a time of peace but of war, and it has been war from the beginning; 2 Esdras 6 shows the foundations of the battle were set from the beginning, and now it is manifest.

Not physical war: there is nothing we can do against these powers physically. What we can do is unite as a people, come back together, keep God’s laws in solidarity, and wait on our redeemer.

“Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered”: dispersed, so that we could be preserved. “In the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said unto them, Ye are the sons of the living God.” We are hearing and seeing it now: our eyes see our teachers, we identify with the curses, and that is how we regain our identity.

“Yet if they shall bethink themselves in the land whither they were carried captives, and repent, and make supplication unto thee in the land of them that carried them captives”. These are the steps: first we remember ourselves and reclaim our identity, part of the strangeness of our salvation; then we repent and do these things; then God acknowledges us, is for us and fights for us.

How do you fight a nuke, or powers that can turn off your lights and take your resources from under your nose? “For after that in the wisdom of God the world by wisdom knew not God”. It was God’s wisdom that they would be blind to it; he made it a mystery so only his elect could unseal what the Bible says.

“It pleased God by the foolishness of preaching to save them that believe.” As it pleases him to see this man in power so he can take him down, by the foolishness of preaching we get our identity back. Look at Maduro and the rest saying these things: our efforts are not small. Even if your camp is slow and there is little foot traffic, none of it is in vain. You go where the fish are and stay until you catch at least one. It starts with preaching, and then it escalates.

sense.text: “Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.” The joy of the Lord is our strength. “Let them praise his name in the dance”: it is not just dancing; there is a purpose behind it, and the end of the psalm shows why we are so happy and praising the Lord.
“For the Lord taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.” He beautifies us with salvation, and something comes with that salvation: “Let the saints be joyful in glory”.

“Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand”: the other side of it. We have the two-edged sword because we are waiting for our retribution. Not now: this is righteous judgment because God ordains it. They say we teach violence; no, there is nothing we can do against it now except get locked up or killed. We praise God, but we are ready for the battle. “To execute vengeance upon the heathen”: that is what the sword is for. “To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron; To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints.” First we repent, then we get the honor; first we repent, then the glory.

precepts.why:
What is some of that honor? Though all these things came on the northern kingdom and all Israel, God will not forget us. “How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver thee, Israel?” How can I deliver you to the heathen for ever? “How shall I make thee as Admah? how shall I set thee as Zeboim?” Those were the cities round about Sodom and Gomorrah that were utterly destroyed; he cannot do that to us. Though he strikes us with the curses in righteous judgment, he has not forgotten us.

“I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger”: all the horror we deal with under these curses is mercy. “They shall walk after the Lord: he shall roar like a lion”: they will repent and roar like a lion, because the tents of Judah are raised first and we follow that example and give honor to the king. “Then the children shall tremble from the west”: the Western Hemisphere. We repent, we foolishly preach, and then we get the honor of Psalm 149.

“They shall tremble as a bird out of Egypt, and as a dove out of the land of Assyria”: once we were a silly dove, but no more. “And I will place them in their houses, saith the Lord”: the sticks joined in Ezekiel. He will tell you, you are Asher, Ephraim, Simeon, Issachar, Zebulun, Naphtali, and we gain back our royal heritage and identity. We do not fight physically now; we repent and we fight through preaching, and God fights for us later.

“Turn you to the strong hold, ye prisoners of hope”: repent. “Even to day do I declare that I will render double unto thee; When I have bent Judah for me, filled the bow with Ephraim”. It is a weapon: Judah first, and then the bow filled with Ephraim, like an arrow. “Raised up thy sons, O Zion, against thy sons, O Greece, and made thee as the sword of a mighty man.” The sons of Greece go into Edom, Esau, Cain, all the countries that rule with a fist of iron.

“And the Lord shall be seen over them, and his arrow shall go forth as the lightning”: that arrow is us, with such power that we move like lightning, Christ leading the charge. This honor have all his saints; we get to move like that too.

“They shall drink, and make a noise as through wine”: so much blood, and a rejoicing; to drink is to partake in the vengeance, the winepress, the two-edged sword in our hand. “They shall be filled like bowls, and as the corners of the altar”: as the blood of the sacrifice filled the bowl and was thrown on the altar, we will be in it, not standing by watching Christ do it. “For they shall be as the stones of a crown, lifted up as an ensign upon his land.” No more the base things: they will see we are the right ones.

“Then shall the righteous man stand in great boldness before the face of such as have afflicted him”: we can stand boldly because what we read in Zechariah has been fulfilled. “They shall be troubled with terrible fear, and shall be amazed at the strangeness of his salvation, so far beyond all that they looked for.” They think it strange now that we reclaimed our identity; wait until they see our king return.

“This was he, whom we had sometimes in derision, and a proverb of reproach”: that is nice words for it; what they will really say is, oh, we done effed up, when they see Christ and the angels as the Bible describes them and the people they mocked with the two-edged sword in our hands, in glory and honor, united. “We fools accounted his life madness, and his end to be without honour”: they crazy, they a cult, they out of their damn mind. “How is he numbered among the children of God, and his lot is among the saints!”

We all get that honor. Now is the time, in our affliction, the eleventh hour, for us to reclaim our glory as in the days of old. Amos 9 does not just mean we come together; it means we come together in valiancy, the valiancy of the northern kingdom tribes. Our people are starting to see it: Cain is raised, and the son of perdition is revealed.
